subject: Flex pricing buckets & reseller commission alignment for private offer
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@saasify.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: SaaSify Procurement <procure@saasify.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer request — flex buckets + channel margin

Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. SaaSify is close to finalizing a pilot and procurement asked me to start the private offer process for our AMER region deal. High-level ask: we want a private offer that supports "flex buckets" (three monthly commit tiers with overage pricing), SKU mapping to our existing subscription SKUs, and clear reseller margin so our channel partner can invoice/resell.

Quick details:
- Estimated initial 12-month commit: $120k ARR, with a ramp to $250k by Q4 if pilot succeeds.
- Need minimum order quantity (MOQ) guidance for marketplace SKUs.
- Channel partner will expect a line-item commission.%

Can you confirm Redwood's typical floor for reseller commission on AWS/GCP private offers, and any constraints on tiered buckets? I attached our MOQ guidance spreadsheet (SaaSify_MOQ_pricing.xlsx).

Appreciate a roadmap of the steps and a rough timeline — procurement wants the PO by the end of May.

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Revenue Operations
SaaSify Inc.
amy@saasify.io
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: SaaSify_MOQ_pricing.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: Private offer request — flex buckets + channel margin

Amy — thanks for the clear summary and the spreadsheet, looks helpful.

Quick answers up front:
- We can support tiered/flex commit buckets in private offers; marketplace SKU mapping is operationally doable but requires SKU pinning and a short lead time (typically 5–7 business days for mapping + QA).
- For channel margin on marketplace private offers, there are two parts: (1) the margin you can show to the reseller on the PO (our recommended reseller commission), and (2) any marketplace platform constraints (AWS/GCP may have minimums or covered fees). I'll loop in Partner Ops and Marketplace PMs for the exact floor and an operational checklist.

Marissa, Karthik — can you weigh in on recommended commission floors for AMER private offers and confirm the SKU mapping workflow? Amy, I've copied procurement in case they want to jump on a call.

Sean
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

We can absolutely do the flex-bucket structure. Operational notes and a recommended waterfall attached (redwood_private_offer_workflow.pdf). Highlights:

- Private offer structure we recommend for SaaSify (AMER):
  * Tier A (Pilot): 0–$50k/mo commit — list price mapping, 8% reseller commission default
  * Tier B (Growth): $50k–$150k/mo — recommended 10% reseller commission
  * Tier C (Enterprise): >$150k/mo — negotiate up to 14% for strategic deals (requires leadership sign-off)

- Marketplace constraints: AWS private offers allow visible reseller margins but have limits on how discounts are applied across SKUs. GCP is slightly more flexible for SKU-level discounts; both require marketplace-side SKU pinning.

- Timeline: if we start mapping SKUs today, expect 5 business days for mapping + validation, then private offer draft in DocuSign within 3 business days after mapping.

I attached the workflow and a template for the private offer. Also marked where Partner Ops needs your PO numbers and partner contact.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request — flex buckets + channel margin

Amy / team —

Adding a few practical constraints from the marketplace/commercial side:

- Minimum commission floors we typically recommend per cloud for AMER deals: AWS 8–10% (10% preferred for channel-first resellers), GCP 10–12%, Azure often mirrors AWS but depends on reseller type. These are recommendations — final visible margin can be adjusted in the private offer but will affect list price and internal accounting.

- For deals that asymptotically exceed $200k ARR within 12 months (your case if pilot scales), we run a flexible uplift clause: above the $200k commit, we can increase reseller commission by 1–2 percentage points subject to Finance approval. If you expect that ramp, flag it now in the PO so we can pre-approve.

- SKU MOQ: marketplace SKUs sometimes require a minimum invoiceable unit; if SaaSify wants SKU-level minimums we should map to consolidated SKUs to avoid multiple small line items. SaaSify_MOQ_pricing.xlsx looks fine but please confirm which SaaSify internal SKUs you want visible on the private offer.

I can draft the commission waterfall and a one-page summary for Finance review.

Karthik
Head of Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. We confirm:
- We'll map to consolidated SKUs to avoid multiple invoice line minimums.
- For the first 6 months we expect to be in Tier A/B range (~$60–90k/mo), so the 10% band is acceptable. If we hit the $200k threshold we'd like the pre-approved uplift clause.

Next steps from our side: procurement will fill out PO metadata and provide the exact SaaSify SKUs by Tuesday. Can you send the DocuSign private offer template (we'll need it to coordinate signatures with our reseller)? Also confirm whether the reseller commission will be visible on the PO that the reseller receives.

Best,
Amy

Amy / team —

Thanks — looping in operational steps below and the DocuSign link for the private offer template.

Operational checklist (quick):
1) SaaSify provides final SKU list + PO metadata (billing contact, partner contact, expected start date).
2) Partner Ops (cc'd) will create SKU mapping and pin SKUs on the marketplace (5 business days).
3) Redwood will prepare private offer draft (we use private_offer_template.docx as the base).
4) DocuSign routing: buyer -> reseller -> Redwood Legal. We will share the signing link once draft is ready.

Visibility: reseller commission line will appear on the PO for AWS and GCP private offers; some marketplaces show the commission as a separate line labeled "Partner Commission". If you want the reseller to invoice directly for the commission, confirm reseller billing details in step (1).
